theorem lean_workbook_plus_48615 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hab : a + b + c = 3) : (Real.sqrt (2 * a ^ 3 + a * b * c) + Real.sqrt (2 * b ^ 3 + a * b * c) + Real.sqrt (2 * c ^ 3 + a * b * c)) ≤ (3 * Real.sqrt 3 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2)) / (a * b + b * c + a * c)   := by

  have h₂ : 0 ≤ b * c := by nlinarith
  have h₃ : 0 ≤ a * c := by nlinarith
  have h₄ : 0 < Real.sqrt 3 := by norm_num
  have h₅ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = 9 - 2 * (a * b + b * c + a * c) := by
    nlinarith
  have h₆ : (Real.sqrt (2 * a ^ 3 + a * b * c) + Real.sqrt (2 * b ^ 3 + a * b * c) + Real.sqrt (2 * c ^ 3 + a * b * c)) ≤ (3 * Real.sqrt 3 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2)) / (a * b + b * c + a * c) := by
    have h₇ : Real.sqrt (2 * a ^ 3 + a * b * c) ≤ (a + a + a) := by
      apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr

      apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr
      constructor
      · nlinarith
